label: Whatever is MOTION_1 moved in some respect is MOTION_3 held in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN analyst sense bridge, attribution deferred (MOTION_1 here is a reading of the binder MovedIn, not a type: the binder is abstract and untagged, since DISAMB-MOTION is pinned by a reviewed bundle audit): if f is being moved (the First Way's MovedIn, MOTION_1, definition a7904c82) in some respect, then f is MOTION_3 held (definition ea1904bc) in some respect: f is in act in that respect and something other than f presently actualizes it there. Its content runs from MOTION_1 to MOTION_3; the route uses it contrapositively (held in no respect, so moved in no respect) to pass from MOTION_3 to MOTION_1. It does not require the holding respect to be the respect of the motion. Strongest support: the First Way's own premise that whatever is moved is moved by another (4a952b96), together with the simultaneity of a per se mover and what it moves, gives a present mover of the moved thing. That support needs a further step to reach this content: from a present mover to a present actualizer (ActualizesNow) in some respect in which f is in act, which is the converse of the mover-side bridge ac93d55a (moving another as presently actualizing it); that converse is not on file. Substantive objection, recorded: accounts on which a motion, once begun, continues without any present mover (inertial uniform motion, and the extrinsic inertialist account of continued being recorded at 40a97664) deny a present actualizer; on those accounts the bridge fails for anything moved only by a past mover.
